reviewed_by: Claude Code Governance v2 task (skills refresh, single production writer)
notes: Refreshed from upstream_commit ed37663c (upstream_tree 04b0fcb7) to 068b6e0c. package.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json versions now both read 1.2.3 -- the prior release/pre-bump drift noted at the previous review is resolved. This refresh also changed the installed-skill inventory from 21 to 23: writing-great-skills was deleted upstream (replaced by an unrelated new skill, writing-for-agents) and is now vendored under that new name/content with a fresh review; wizard and wait-what, newly promoted upstream in this release, were added after separate explicit owner authorization. to-questionnaire (also newly promoted) and setup-matt-pocock-skills remain excluded. See docs/agents/mattpocock-skills-policy.md for the update-procedure write-up and docs/agents/mattpocock-skills-patches.md for every patch touched by this refresh.

skills.name: wait-what
skills.notes: Newly promoted upstream in this refresh; added after separate explicit owner authorization (was excluded pending review). Already user-invoked upstream (disable-model-invocation: true) -- kept as-is. Read-only, grants no new capability.

skills.name: wizard
skills.notes: Newly promoted upstream in this refresh; added after separate explicit owner authorization (was excluded pending review). Moved from model- to user-invoked (disable-model-invocation: true). Ships a sibling script, template.sh (upstream_blob_sha/vendored_blob_sha both fdc2a72...e5b28ab -- see files list); template.sh itself is unpatched (byte-identical to upstream) because it is only ever run by the human, never the agent -- the governance gate lives in SKILL.md.

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.notes: Replaces writing-great-skills, which upstream deleted between ed37663c and 068b6e0c (not a rename -- different name, different file structure, fully rewritten content; git's rename detector did not match the two). Re-reviewed from scratch and vendored under its new name after separate explicit owner authorization. Moved from model- to user-invoked (disable-model-invocation: true); the old writing-great-skills was already user-invoked, so this preserves that posture rather than broadening it. Ships a sibling reference file, SKILL-MECHANICS.md (unpatched, byte-identical to upstream).
